    test_file = Path(filename)

    # Only process python files
    if not test_file.suffix == ".py":
        return []

    # Only process test files
    if "test" not in test_file.stem:
        return []

    test_dir = test_file.parent

    # Find test file's related files
    related_files = utils.get_related_files(test_file)
    test_file_related_paths = [str(p.relative_to(test_dir)) for p in related_files]
    test_file_related_names = [str(p.name) for p in related_files]

    # Find all files in the same directory as the test file
    # (ignoring files already processed)
    all_files_in_dir = utils.get_files_in_dir(test_dir,
                                              include_test_files=True)
    all_files_in_dir_paths = [str(p.relative_to(test_dir)) for p in all_files_in_dir]
    all_files_in_dir_names = [str(p.name) for p in all_files_in_dir]

    # Find all related files
    all_related_paths = list(set(test_file_related_paths + all_files_in_dir_paths))
    all_related_names = list(set(test_file_related_names + all_files_in_dir_names))

    # Get all files in the project
    all_files = utils.get_files_in_dir(test_dir,
                                       include_test_files=False)
    all_files_paths = [str(p.relative_to(test_dir)) for p in all_files]
    all_files_names = [str(p.name) for p in all_files]

    # Filter out files that don't belong in the same directory as the test file
    all_files_in_same_dir = []
